text:
jamie (sales): Hey finance — need one-off approval for a pilot concession for VelvetHealth. Sales wants a 3mo pilot with 60% off list pricing for hosted inference. They say strategic payer customer, potential 12mo renewal. Can we fast-track? :pray:
mira (finance): What are the numbers? show ARR motion and expected pilot spend so we can run net impact. Also any required contract changes?
jamie (sales): Estimated usage during pilot ~2.5M tokens/mo. List pricing would be ~ $0.03/token => ~$2,250/mo, wait math off — correction: list is per-token fractional; estimated pilot list cost ~ $9k total over 3mo. With 60% off they'd pay ~$3.6k. If converted to 12mo commit, projected ARR ~$54k. Pilot is required to validate private deployment + HL7 connector.
david (revops): Need gross-to-net calc and GL treatment. If we give 60% off on pilot we should capture as a one-time marketing concession (GL: 5302) and note for revenue ops reconciliation. Also prefer a cap on total pilot credits. Recommend cap = $5k.
mira (finance): Agree with cap. 60% seems high for a pilot with this size. We can approve up to 50% off if there's a signed LOI committing to an evaluation timeline and an onboarding fee.
jamie (sales): Can we do 50% plus a $2k onboarding fee and a $5k pilot cap? Customer will sign an LOI if we confirm.
sophia (head of finance): Conditional approval: 50% max discount, pilot credit cap $5k, onboarding fee required, and finance needs the deal desk ticket with estimated ARR uplift and expected conversion KPI. Any discount beyond 50% requires VP approval. :white_check_mark:
liz (legal): We'll need an SOW that limits scope of pilot, data handling addendum (PHI clarification), and liability caps. Send draft to legal for a 48hr turnaround.
jamie (sales): Roger. I'll draft LOI + SOW and attach privacy addendum. tagging @sales-bot to create a deal desk entry.
sales-bot: /dealdesk create customer=VelvetHealth pilot_discount=50% pilot_cap=5000 onboarding_fee=2000 expected_ARR=54000 notes="private deployment, HL7"
finance-bot: To finalize, finance needs: 1) deal desk ticket URL, 2) signed LOI (pdf), 3) SOW with pilot scope, 4) GL code confirmation. Once received, finance will mark as approved and generate concession memo.
mira (finance): I'll review the deal desk ticket when created, confirm GL code and generate concession memo for records.
jamie (sales): Thanks everyone — will upload docs and follow up. tagging @liz for legal review ETA 48h. :thumbsup:
sophia (head of finance): Keep thread updated. If legal flags PHI risk, hold on activation until mitigations are in place.
jamie (sales): Will do — closing loop once docs uploaded. Thanks all.
